parameters.description: Only campaigns that contain all supplied tags are returned.

parameters.description: Return campaigns sent on or after this UTC ISO-8601 date-time.

get.summary: Get Contacts Based on Your Criteria
get.description: Finds contacts in Dotdigital by selected criteria.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: dataFields
parameters.description: Pipe-delimited contact data field keys to return, or [[ALL]] to return all data fields.

schema.description: Pipe-delimited contact data field keys to return, or [[ALL]] to return all data fields. Pass multiple values separated by `|`.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Additional contact datasets to include in the response.

schema.description: Additional contact datasets to include in the response. Pass multiple values separated by `|`.

parameters.name: created
parameters.description: Use gte::YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ to filter by created date. Do not use with Modified Filter.

schema.description: Use gte::YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ to filter by created date. Do not use with Modified Filter.

parameters.name: modified
parameters.description: Use gte::YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ to filter by modified date.

schema.description: Use gte::YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ to filter by modified date.

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: Filter to a specific list. Do not use with Segment ID Filter.

schema.description: Filter to a specific list. Do not use with Segment ID Filter.

parameters.name: segmentId
parameters.description: Filter to a specific segment. Do not use with List ID Filter.

schema.description: Filter to a specific segment. Do not use with List ID Filter.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
